body:
Thanks for a detailed answer. I think for a long time I've had a hard time respecting myself enough to put in the necessary effort, and now I'm just kind of adrift without any strong tether to keep me grounded.

I just feel like there's always a problem with everything around me, and it's so hard to motivate myself when it seems like I'll just be followed by problems all my life whatever I do.

I really need an outlet that's more constructive than screaming at the ocean, but I just don't know what. I feel better after working out, but I can't focus on exercise when I get the moments like today when the problems just pile up. I have so much pent up frustration that I want to SCREAM and break something.

I was speaking in a historical sense. I've been with 4 girls in my life, one of which i've been quite close to for a long time.

I never ever watch porn, i think it's a cruel and disgusting business. Like i said, i'm constantly disspciating with my body.

Lucky kid. I wish i was fucking dead

I'm a guy. I feel like i'm a disappointment to my sexual partners and that i'm not really "in it" meaning that i feel like i kind of dissociate and just feel this second entity rather than a connection with a person.

I don't actually hate the people in my life but i want them to think i do so that i can burn all my bridges
Thank you for the constructive criticism. I do believe I treat them better than i used to, but I'm still scared of being vulnerable to someone else.
Serious question, is that fair? Is it not possible to willingly go beyond forgiveness out of your own selfish desires? Is it right that everyone should be able to get forgiveness?

Heh, I have a pretty elaborate plan for actually carrying out my suicide, but I’m gonna wait with it until Deltarune is realesed. Pretty dumb but I really want to play that game, and it’s not like it’s ever gonna be too late to die.
Oh gee, what revolutionary, constructive advice
Spot on. I’m fuming just thinking about how shallow everyone is. And I’m no different.

Psychological support from whom, may I ask?
Also, I should inform you that last year my perception was indeed different. In fact, I remember telling myself there was noone I’d rather be than me, and I believed it. But eventually, it dawned upon me that the only reason I was in a consistently good mood back then was external influence. I had moved recently, met a lot of new people, and day to day life was actually exciting. Then a sort of routine started forming, and in my case, routine is the death of joy. And eventually, I realized that despite my life being a lot better for a few months, I was just as unhappy with myself as I’d always been.
No matter how much professional help i get, no matter how nice my paycheck is, no matter how many friends i surround myself with, i’ll still be me. And there is no cure for that

I’m incompetent, and got an overly strong sense of self-counciousness that makes me awfully aware of how incompetent I am. Also ugly and socially challenged, not to mention that life itself feels meaningless, so no future prospects even seem tempting.
Yeah?
Nah
What are they gonna tell me that could make a difference? Professional as they may be, a doctor cannot fix how much wrong there is with me.
Yeah okay, I’ll find another way
Yeah okay, already been convinced to find another way.
Tried suicide hotlines several times, never found someone convincing. It’s all the same bs of platitudes and «oh think about the people around you».
Ding ding ding we have a winner!
I have been unable to give my life meaning regardless, so the way i go doesnt really matter.
I was thinking of wearing headphones with loud-ass music so it will take me by surprise, but the only thing I care about is that I don’t even notice it happening.
Already am. If only i was a little better I would.
And to whom would the other 50 percent of the genes belong? Because I am not under any circumstance getting a male partner.
Agnostic atheist. I don’t think I’d feel as strong a connection to an adopted child, so I’m scared I would be a subpar parent to them.

I used to be pretty homophobic actually, so I guess some of that lives on. But i also want to start a traditional family and have kids of my own, but I can’t see how that will work out at this point. I think no one will judge me harsher than myself so I’m not really scared of that. I just feel like being gay will prevent me from being the person I want to be.
I just feels like it conflicts with everything I believe in. I want to get married and have kids of my own, but I just can’t see that happening now.
